name: figure-agent
description: Paper-figure quality kernel for semantic TikZ compile, visual QA, reproducible exports, and fail-closed readiness checks.

interface.shortDescription: Compile, inspect, and guard scientific schematics
interface.longDescription: Figure Agent keeps scientific schematic authoring free while enforcing style, semantic, compile, export, and visual-QA contracts. It does not claim publication acceptance: human review remains an explicit gate.
defaultPrompt: Inspect this scientific schematic and route the next safe Figure Agent action.
Compile this figure and report semantic or visual QA blockers.
Prepare a reproducible figure status and human-review handoff.
